title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Synthesis-aware generative design in trillion-scale chemical spaces for automated drug discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Autonomous drug discovery via generative molecular design is critically bottlenecked by the production of chemically intractable structures. Multi-trillion-scale make-on-demand libraries guarantee synthetic feasibility, but conventional virtual screening cannot efficiently navigate these vast spaces or address multi-parameter optimization. We introduce Hyper Screening X, a generative AI framework integrating structure-based design with automated synthesis hardware. By encoding deterministic reaction logic in a generative flow network, the framework evaluates only 10 million candidates to navigate an 11-trillion-compound space, jointly optimizing physicochemical properties while ensuring compatibility with automated synthesis. Prospective validation against an SLC1A5 variant with a cryptic interface yielded a 96% synthesis success rate and a 50% functional hit rate, identifying two first-in-class lead compounds. This synthesis-aware strategy advances autonomous, closed-loop drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: Hyper Screening X将结构导向生成设计、确定性反应逻辑和自动化合成硬件整合，在11万亿可合成化合物空间中仅评估1000万候选物；面向具有隐蔽界面的SLC1A5变体开展前瞻验证，获得96%的合成成功率、50%的功能命中率及两种首创先导物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把可合成性直接嵌入生成搜索，并以真实合成与功能实验闭环验证，是自动化药物发现的重要一步；但验证集中于单一靶点变体，命中物的选择性、药代与体内疗效仍未说明。
items.abstract_zh: 通过生成式分子设计实现自主药物发现，关键瓶颈在于会产生化学上难以实现的结构。数万亿规模的按需合成化合物库能够保证合成可行性，但传统虚拟筛选无法高效探索如此庞大的空间，也无法解决多参数优化问题。我们提出Hyper Screening X，一种将结构导向设计与自动化合成硬件整合的生成式AI框架。该框架在生成流网络中编码确定性反应逻辑，仅评估1000万候选物便可探索一个包含11万亿化合物的空间，在确保与自动化合成兼容的同时联合优化理化性质。针对具有隐蔽界面的SLC1A5变体开展的前瞻性验证，取得了96%的合成成功率和50%的功能命中率，并鉴定出两种首创先导化合物。这一合成感知策略推动了自主、闭环药物发现。
items.author_line: Seo, S., Sung, Y., Hwang, S.-Y., Kang, M., Lee, J., Bordi, S., Raguz, L., Choi, J., Melnichenko, D., Namkung, W., Lee, S., Lim, J., Wanner, B. M., Han, J. M., Kim, W. Y.

items.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
items.abstract_or_text: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.
items.summary_zh: CircuitATLAS构建了含383万节点、766万边的可溯源神经科学知识图谱，并以智能体从疾病表型推理至回路、细胞和分子干预。在体内4-aminopyridine挑战中，ATP1A3的中间神经元限制性表达消除了β和γ频段反应，随后进入结构导向小分子开发。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将知识图谱、智能体推理和人类监督的体内实验串为靶点发现闭环，并刻意移除疾病—基因/蛋白捷径边以检验推理链；但目前核心验证集中于一个回路控制点，治疗调控方向和临床可转化性尚待明确。
items.abstract_zh: 神经系统疾病的药物发现传统上以疾病中发生改变的分子为中心。但导致病理的分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点。我们在此提出问题：可动用哪些本身未发生改变的分子控制点，以将病理性神经回路恢复至功能状态。我们提出CircuitATLAS，这是一个以溯源为基础的系统神经科学知识图谱和用于回路病靶点发现的智能体框架。它组织了来自文献的疾病、表型、电生理、回路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应因子之间的关系，同时有意排除直接的疾病—基因和疾病—蛋白边，以减少捷径式推理。该图谱包含383万个节点和766万条边，其中包括531万条由LLM提取的关系，并纳入Human Cell Atlas等结构化数据集和新的多模态体内测量。随后，我们引入一种智能体工作流：它从可测量的疾病表型出发，经由其回路和细胞底物，推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束。最后，我们引入由人类治理的体内实验室闭环，将假设生成与实验迭代相连。在该框架内，一个智能体提名ATP1A3——神经元alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase——为皮层兴奋性的控制点；ATP1A3在中间神经元中的限制性表达，在体内消除了对局灶4-aminopyridine挑战的beta和gamma频段反应；这一经验证靶点随后被带入一项结构导向的小分子项目，项目以一个明确的测定终止，用于判定调控方向。因此，CircuitATLAS为发现治疗方法提供了一个框架：其依据不仅是疾病中哪些分子受损，也包括哪些分子能够被控制以恢复回路功能。

items.title: Evaluating Autonomous LLM Agents Across Molecular Prediction and Optimization Benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of carrying out autonomous computational research, but it remains unclear whether they can develop molecular modeling methods that compete with strong human-developed approaches. Here, we evaluate autonomous method development across four settings: Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC) ADMET tasks, the OpenADMET ExpansionRx Challenge, the activity prediction track of the OpenADMET PXR Induction Challenge, and the Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark. Agents followed the prescribed data splits, metrics, and evaluation protocols for each benchmark. On TDC, the best agent-developed score across configurations improved on the leaderboard reference on 18 of 21 tasks and on the combined leaderboard and peer-reviewed reference on 17, while individual Codex configurations improved on the combined reference on 13 tasks. On ExpansionRx, five-agent and single-agent Codex configurations achieved overall scores corresponding to fourth and sixth place relative to the published final leaderboard, with the five-agent configuration reaching top-five performance on seven of nine endpoints. On PXR, five-agent Codex achieved a mean absolute error slightly outperforming the best published challenge entry. On PMO, five-agent Codex developed a molecular optimizer that outperformed existing methods evaluated under the benchmark's standard setup; other methods obtained higher reported scores under modified conditions, including additional molecular pretraining data or a different oracle-call budget. Together, these results show that current LLM agents can autonomously develop high-performing molecular prediction and optimization methods across substantially different drug-discovery settings, in several cases matching or exceeding leading human-developed approaches.
items.summary_zh: 研究在TDC ADMET、OpenADMET ExpansionRx、PXR Induction和PMO四类基准上评估自主LLM智能体开发分子方法的能力；多智能体Codex在若干标准设置下达到或超过已发表参照方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对“智能体能否自主形成有竞争力的分子建模方法”的跨任务、按既定评测协议的直接检验；不过结果仍高度依赖具体基准、配置和计算预算，不能等同于对真实药物发现成功率的证明。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益能够开展自主计算研究，但它们能否开发出可与强大的人类开发方法竞争的分子建模方法，仍不清楚。这里，我们在四种场景中评估自主方法开发：Therapeutics Data Commons（TDC）ADMET任务、OpenADMET ExpansionRx Challenge、OpenADMET PXR Induction Challenge的活性预测赛道，以及Practical Molecular Optimization（PMO）基准。智能体遵循了每项基准所规定的数据划分、指标和评估协议。在TDC上，各种配置中得分最佳的智能体开发方法在21项任务中的18项优于排行榜参考值，在17项任务中优于排行榜和同行评议参考值的综合参照；各个Codex配置在13项任务中优于综合参照。在ExpansionRx上，五智能体和单智能体Codex配置的总分，相对于已公布的最终排行榜分别相当于第四名和第六名；五智能体配置在9个终点中的7个达到了前五名表现。在PXR上，五智能体Codex取得的平均绝对误差略优于已发表挑战赛最佳条目。在PMO上，五智能体Codex开发的分子优化器在该基准标准设置下优于现有方法；其他方法则在修改后的条件下报告了更高分数，包括使用额外分子预训练数据或不同的oracle调用预算。总体而言，这些结果表明，当前LLM智能体能够在大相径庭的药物发现任务中自主开发高性能分子预测和优化方法，并在若干情况下匹配或超过领先的人类开发方法。
items.author_line: Smbatyan, K., Ghukasyan, T., Petrosyan, G.

items.title: LLM-Assisted Generation of Transparent, Open-Source Multiphysics Models of Electrochemical Devices
items.abstract_or_text: Multiphysics continuum models are powerful tools for studying electrochemical devices, enabling in silico reactor design and resolution of local pH, potential, and concentration fields that govern device performance but are difficult to measure experimentally. However, constructing such models requires substantial numerical expertise or reliance on proprietary software. Here, we show that frontier large language model agents can remove this implementation burden while keeping the underlying physics under researcher control. Using one-dimensional electrochemical CO2 reduction to CO in a porous gas diffusion electrode as a test case, we develop a machine-readable, human-specified modeling harness containing governing equations, parameters, numerical methods, logical build stages, and human-verifiable checkpoints. From this specification, the agent reproducibly constructs complete multiphysics models in open-source Julia. Independently built models, including fully autonomous agent-built models, agree with an equivalent COMSOL implementation to within 0.7% of the peak CO partial current density, and with one another to within 0.04%. Systematically planted errors demonstrate the importance of explicit specifications for reproducibility and reveal the agent's capabilities and limitations in debugging model physics. This framework establishes a more transparent approach to multiphysics modeling in which physical descriptions and governing equations, rather than specialized code, become the primary inputs for computational model development.
items.summary_zh: 作者以多孔气体扩散电极中CO2还原为CO为例，提出机器可读且由研究者指定的建模规范，使LLM智能体在开源Julia中可复现地构建多物理场模型。独立构建的模型与COMSOL峰值CO分电流密度相差不超过0.7%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作显示将控制方程、参数和可核查节点明确外化，可使智能体辅助的电化学建模具备透明性与可复现性；但示范限于一维单一反应器，复杂界面化学和更广泛器件上的可靠性仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 多物理场连续介质模型是研究电化学器件的强大工具，能够实现计算机内反应器设计，并解析决定器件性能却难以测量的局部pH、电势和浓度场。然而，构建这类模型需要大量数值专业知识，或依赖专有软件。这里，我们表明前沿大语言模型智能体能够消除这一实现负担，同时使底层物理仍受研究者控制。以多孔气体扩散电极中一维电化学CO2还原为CO为测试案例，我们开发了一个机器可读、由人类指定的建模工具链，其中包含控制方程、参数、数值方法、逻辑构建阶段和可由人类核查的检查点。智能体由此规范出发，在开源Julia中可复现地构建完整的多物理场模型。独立构建的模型，包括完全由自主智能体构建的模型，与等效COMSOL实现的峰值CO分电流密度相差在0.7%以内，彼此之间相差在0.04%以内。系统性植入的错误表明，明确规范对于可复现性至关重要，也揭示了智能体在调试模型物理方面的能力和局限。这一框架建立了一种更透明的多物理场建模方法：物理描述和控制方程，而非专门代码，成为计算模型开发的主要输入。
items.author_line: Sebastian Castro, Maya F. Schuchert, Spencer A. McCluskey, Eric W. Lees, Justin C. Bui

items.title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
items.abstract_or_text: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.
items.summary_zh: DrugTargetWorld程序化生成因果真值隐藏的合成生物库，每个世界含54,000名参与者的基因型、蛋白、病历、结局和合成MRI，并用20个心血管世界中的540次任务评估9种智能体的端到端靶点发现。最佳智能体平均仅恢复64%的因果驱动蛋白。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准以已知却对智能体隐藏的因果结构，解决了真实生物库难以验证端到端靶点发现的问题，并暴露出现有智能体区分非因果蛋白的短板；不过合成世界与真实疾病机制、数据偏倚和实验复杂度仍存在距离。
items.abstract_zh: 药物靶点发现要求区分在因果上驱动疾病的分子与仅仅和疾病相关的分子。训练和评估AI智能体端到端完成这一工作流很困难，因为真实世界生物库缺乏已知的因果真值，而且参与者层面数据受到访问控制。我们提出DrugTargetWorld，这是一个程序化生成模拟生物库或“世界”的框架，其因果结构已知但被隐藏。每个世界包含54,000名参与者的基因型、蛋白、健康记录、结局和合成磁共振成像（MRI）。智能体必须构建疾病表型、识别因果驱动蛋白、推断有益的调控方向，并可选择开展虚拟“湿实验”。我们在20个心血管世界和三种实验预算中，以540个回合评估了9个智能体。Opus 5和GPT-5.6 Sol取得最高平均综合得分，分别为100分中的39.98和35.38，二者平均均找回了64%的因果驱动因子。然而，没有智能体能够可靠地区分具有误导性的非因果蛋白，而且其表现仍受限于将表型构建、因果证据和干预决策连接起来所需的整合性判断。通过使每个世界的因果结构对评估者已知、对智能体隐藏，DrugTargetWorld将端到端药物靶点发现转化为具有可验证奖励的可扩展训练与评估问题。
items.author_line: Samuel Margolis, Paul Schmiedmayer, Alan Huang, Ethan Chen, Ishan Bhattacharjee, Atman Shah, Ben Viggiano, Fang Cao, Shriya Reddy, Roger Xia, Jack O'Sullivan, Daniel Katz, Matthew Wheeler, Euan Ashley, Bruna Gomes

items.title: Polymer Property Prediction via an Automated Molecular Dynamics Pipeline and Transfer Learning
items.abstract_or_text: For many existing and emerging applications, there is a great need to develop novel polymeric materials with highly tuned properties. In the quest to design materials from highly abundant natural resources or waste materials, there is a vast design space that has remained substantially unexplored. Machine learning approaches can help guide toward improved properties, but these approaches often suffer from a lack of high quality data, the acquisition of which can be tedious, time-consuming, and expensive. In silico atomistic simulations are a promising approach to generate data that are highly correlated to real polymer properties, but simulations of polymers present myriad challenges including accurate and automatic force field parameterization, initial configuration generation, and long relaxation times which make it extremely difficult to perform such simulations in a high-throughput manner. Here, we present a computational pipeline starting from SMILES strings of reactants to automatically generate force field parameters and initial system coordinates for subsequent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of short oligomers that have much faster relaxation times than the corresponding polymer melts. Because most measurable properties of oligomeric fluids are not the same as those of the corresponding polymers of much higher degree of polymerization, and indeed many properties of polymer phases do not exist for such liquids, we employ a transfer learning scheme to predict polymer properties from the oligomer thermophysical data. Using this approach, we are able to achieve improved property predictions for a number of polymer properties, including gas permeabilities. These improvements are most dramatic when experimental data are sparse and when the experimental observables are most directly correlated to simulation properties.
items.summary_zh: 研究从反应物SMILES自动生成短低聚物的力场参数和初始构型，再以迁移学习从其热物性预测高聚物性质；在实验数据稀缺且性质与模拟量相关性高时，特别改善了包括气体渗透率在内的预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 自动化MD与迁移学习结合，有望降低聚合物材料数据获得成本并支持稀疏数据下的筛选；但短低聚物液体到高聚物相态的外推是核心假设，性能仍受力场质量和可用实验标签限制。
items.abstract_zh: 对于许多现有和新兴应用，迫切需要开发性质经过高度调控的新型聚合物材料。在利用丰富天然资源或废弃材料进行材料设计的探索中，仍有一个基本未被开发的巨大设计空间。机器学习方法可以帮助引导至更优性质，但这些方法常受制于高质量数据缺乏，而获取这些数据可能繁琐、耗时且昂贵。计算机内原子级模拟是生成与真实聚合物性质高度相关数据的一种有前景方法，但聚合物模拟存在诸多挑战，包括准确且自动的力场参数化、初始构型生成和漫长的松弛时间，因此极难高通量开展此类模拟。这里，我们提出一条计算流程：从反应物的SMILES字符串出发，自动生成用于后续分子动力学（MD）模拟的力场参数和初始体系坐标，模拟对象为比相应聚合物熔体松弛更快的短低聚物。由于低聚物流体的大多数可测性质与聚合度高得多的相应聚合物并不相同，事实上聚合物相的许多性质在此类液体中根本不存在，我们采用迁移学习方案，从低聚物热物性数据预测聚合物性质。使用这一方法，我们能够改进多项聚合物性质的预测，包括气体渗透率。当实验数据稀缺且实验观测量与模拟性质最直接相关时，这些改进最为显著。
items.author_line: Jeffrey N. Law, Daria Lazarenko, Timotej Bernat, Brandon C. Knott, Michael R. Shirts

items.title: Beyond Organic Molecules: MetalLipoDB, a Lipophilicity Dataset for Metal Complexes and Machine Learning Benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: Lipophilicity governs the uptake, distribution and toxicity of drug candidates, yet the experimental logP datasets used to build predictive models contain almost exclusively organic molecules. Here we present MetalLipoDB, a manually curated dataset of 5158 experimental logP and logD values of complexes of 23 metals from 1192 articles, including 556 entries for multinuclear and heterometallic complexes, annotated with the measurement conditions and counterions. The dataset quantifies the inter-study reproducibility of these measurements (0.56 log units) and serves as a benchmark for machine learning, with a mean absolute error of 0.72–0.75 for complexes from unseen articles. For articles with at least four measurements, anchoring the predictions to three measured complexes of the series reduced the error on the remaining complexes from 0.73 to 0.51. MetalLipoDB, the code and an interactive web application (https://biometaldb.streamlit.app/) are openly available to support the design of metal-based drugs.
items.summary_zh: MetalLipoDB手工整理23种金属配合物、来自1,192篇文献的5,158个实验logP/logD值，并提供机器学习基准。对未见文献中配合物的MAE为0.72–0.75；以同系列3个实测配合物锚定可将其余化合物误差降至0.51。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该资源补足了金属药物设计中长期缺乏的脂溶性数据与条件注释，并量化跨文献测量的0.56 log单位变异；但数据异质性和未见文献上的误差表明，模型尚不能替代特定系列的实验测定。
items.abstract_zh: 脂溶性决定候选药物的摄取、分布和毒性，但用于构建预测模型的实验logP数据集几乎只包含有机分子。这里，我们提出MetalLipoDB：一个手工整理的数据集，收录了来自1192篇文章、涵盖23种金属配合物的5158个实验logP和logD数值，其中包括556条多核和异金属配合物记录，并标注测量条件和反离子。该数据集量化了这些测量的跨研究可重复性（0.56 log单位），并作为机器学习基准：对于来自未见文章的配合物，平均绝对误差为0.72–0.75。对于至少含有4项测量的文章，以该系列中3种实测配合物锚定预测，可将其余配合物的误差从0.73降至0.51。MetalLipoDB、代码和交互式网页应用（https://biometaldb.streamlit.app/）均已开放，可支持金属药物设计。
items.author_line: Lev Krasnov, Dmitriy Malikov, Marina A. Kiseleva, Artem Lvov, Sergei V. Tatarin, Stanislav I. Bezzubov

items.title: Accelerating dynamic polarizability calculations of organic molecules using equivariant graph neural networks
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting the dynamic polarizability tensor of organic molecules is essential for simulating light-matter interactions in optoelectronic devices, yet conventional quantum-chemical methods such as time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) are computationally expensive and limit large-scale screening. We present an equivariant graph neural network architecture that predicts frequency-dependent, complex-valued dynamic polarizability tensors directly from readily available molecular information, such as 3D geometry and UV-vis spectra. The model learns to approximate the shape and magnitude of the dynamic polarizability tensor, capturing both dispersive and absorptive features that define the molecular optical response. We evaluate the model on molecules from both the QM9 dataset and the Harvard organic photovoltaic dataset using various metrics, including the earth mover's distance, which is suitable for comparing spectral quantities. For both datasets, the model successfully reproduces the main features of the dynamic polarizability tensor and generalizes across diverse molecules. To assess the applicability, we further validated the model using a downstream workflow to calculate the optical properties of organic photovoltaic devices. We used the model-predicted polarizabilities to perform device-level optical simulations, yielding charge carrier generation rates in agreement with TD-DFT-based results (R^2 = 0.94). Our approach offers a promising complement, or even an alternative, to conventional methods such as TD-DFT, enabling faster and more efficient screening of photoactive organic molecules for optoelectronic applications.
items.summary_zh: 研究用等变图神经网络从3D几何和UV-vis光谱预测有机分子的频率依赖复动态极化率张量，并在QM9和Harvard有机光伏数据集上测试；将预测值用于器件光学模拟时，载流子产生率与TD-DFT结果的R²为0.94。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法瞄准光电材料筛选中昂贵的TD-DFT瓶颈，并提供下游器件级验证；但可推广性目前限于两个数据集和相近化学空间，对激发态复杂体系及域外分子的误差仍须检验。
items.abstract_zh: 预测有机分子的动态极化率张量对于模拟光电器件中的光—物质相互作用至关重要，然而诸如含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）等传统量子化学方法计算成本高昂，限制了大规模筛选。我们提出一种等变图神经网络架构，能够直接从易得的分子信息，如3D几何和UV-vis光谱，预测频率依赖、复值的动态极化率张量。该模型学习近似动态极化率张量的形状和幅度，捕捉定义分子光学响应的色散和吸收特征。我们使用多种指标在QM9数据集和Harvard有机光伏数据集的分子上评估该模型，其中包括适于比较光谱量的earth mover's distance。对于两个数据集，该模型均成功再现了动态极化率张量的主要特征，并能在多样分子间泛化。为评估适用性，我们还利用下游工作流计算有机光伏器件的光学性质。我们使用模型预测的极化率开展器件层面光学模拟，得到的载流子产生率与基于TD-DFT的结果一致（R² = 0.94）。我们的方法为TD-DFT等传统方法提供了有前景的补充，甚至可能成为其替代方案，从而能够更快速、更高效地筛选用于光电应用的光活性有机分子。
items.author_line: Houssam Metni, Maria Kraus, Marie Louise Schubert, Marjan Krstic, Carsten Rockstuhl, Pascal Friederich

items.title: Toward a Transferable Representation of Protein Dynamics for Functional Prediction and Mechanistic Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Protein function is determined not only by the static structure of molecules, but also by coordinated conformational fluctuations that occur across various spatial and temporal scales. Molecular dynamics simulations, elastic network models, principal component analysis, and related approaches offer useful descriptions of protein motion. However, representing heterogeneous trajectories in a compact, informative manner that is applicable to proteins with different sequences, structures, and historical evolution is not trivial. Here we present the Topology Invariant Dynamic Graph Network (TIDGN), a deep representation learning approach that encodes protein conformational dynamics into a shared latent representation, termed the protein motion signature (Zp). TIDGN encodes each trajectory as a time-dependent residue-level graph and builds structural connectivity, dynamic cross-correlation, low-dimensional motion features, sequence context, and temporal aggregation into the design. Instead of learning a protein-specific collective variable, the approach learns a representation that retains functionally informative patterns of coordinated motion applicable to different proteins. We evaluate the framework using 1,250 molecular-dynamics trajectories representing 1,120 distinct proteins that range in size from 50-600 residues, 142 CATH/SCOP families, 88 structural folds, and six broad functional classes. The set of trajectories spans durations of 100 ns to 10 (mu)s, sampled at 100 ps intervals, representing approximately 12.5 million conformational frames in total. In the context of a sequence-disjoint evaluation using a 30% sequence-identity threshold, the approach achieves a mean AUROC of 0.8838 (margin of error:) 0.0107 compared to 0.8174 for a dynamic graph neural-network baseline, 0.7257 for a dynamic descriptor, 0.7227 for a PCA descriptor, 0.6592 for a sequence baseline, and 0.6587 for a static-structure baseline. As the biological distance between training and evaluation proteins increases, transfer performance decreases, with AUROC values of 0.92 for random splitting, 0.85 for sequence-disjoint evaluation, 0.78 for family-disjoint evaluation, and 0.71 for fold-disjoint evaluation. Component ablations suggest that graph structure, dynamic cross-correlation, low-dimensional motion features, sequence information, and the combination of these factors contribute to predictive performance. Residue-level attribution, when applied to adenylate kinase, highlights regions that are associated with known conformational rearrangements that involve the LID and NMP domains, offering a biologically interpretable hypothesis about the dynamic information that is encoded by the model. Taken together, these results suggest that it is possible to learn transferable representations of protein dynamics that retain functionally informative patterns of coordinated motion beyond considerations of sequence identity and static structure. Moreover, although the learned representation is transferable, it is not universally invariant to the biological distance between training and evaluation proteins. The resulting approach offers a computational basis for connecting molecular motion, functional prediction, and mechanistically informative representation learning.
items.summary_zh: TIDGN将蛋白MD轨迹编码为时间依赖残基图并学习可迁移的蛋白运动表征。在1,250条轨迹、1,120种蛋白的序列去重评测中，平均AUROC为0.8838，优于动态图网络及静态结构、序列等基线；跨家族和跨折叠时性能明显下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试把动态构象信息转化为可跨蛋白使用的功能表征，并以严格的序列去重、消融和归因分析支持其有效性；但生物距离增大时的性能下降表明“可迁移”并非普适，尚需面向实验功能预测检验。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质功能不仅由分子的静态结构决定，也由发生在多种空间和时间尺度上的协调构象涨落决定。分子动力学模拟、弹性网络模型、主成分分析及相关方法可对蛋白运动提供有用描述。然而，要将异质轨迹表示为紧凑、信息丰富，且适用于具有不同序列、结构和进化历史的蛋白质的形式，并不容易。这里，我们提出Topology Invariant Dynamic Graph Network（TIDGN），一种深度表征学习方法，将蛋白构象动力学编码为共享的潜在表征，称为蛋白运动特征（Zp）。TIDGN将每条轨迹编码为随时间变化的残基级图，并将结构连通性、动态交叉相关、低维运动特征、序列上下文和时间聚合纳入设计。该方法并非学习蛋白特异性的集体变量，而是学习一种表征：它保留可适用于不同蛋白的、具有功能信息的协调运动模式。我们使用1,250条分子动力学轨迹评估该框架，这些轨迹代表1,120种不同蛋白，大小范围为50–600个残基、涵盖142个CATH/SCOP家族、88种结构折叠和六大功能类别。该组轨迹持续时间为100 ns至10 (mu)s，以100 ps间隔采样，总计约1,250万个构象帧。在以30%序列同一性阈值进行的序列去重评估中，该方法获得0.8838的平均AUROC（误差范围：0.0107），而动态图神经网络基线为0.8174，动态描述符为0.7257，PCA描述符为0.7227，序列基线为0.6592，静态结构基线为0.6587。随着训练蛋白与评估蛋白的生物距离增大，迁移性能下降：随机划分、序列去重评估、家族去重评估和折叠去重评估的AUROC分别为0.92、0.85、0.78和0.71。组分消融表明，图结构、动态交叉相关、低维运动特征、序列信息及其组合均有助于预测性能。将残基级归因用于adenylate kinase时，突出了与涉及LID和NMP结构域的已知构象重排相关的区域，为模型所编码的动态信息提供了一个具有生物学可解释性的假设。总之，这些结果表明，可以学习到蛋白动力学的可迁移表征：它保留超越序列同一性和静态结构考量的、具有功能信息的协调运动模式。此外，尽管该学习表征具有可迁移性，但它并不对生物距离普遍不变。由此产生的方法为连接分子运动、功能预测和具有机制信息的表征学习提供了计算基础。

items.title: AI agent supervision of structural model building and refinement
items.abstract_or_text: Structural model building and refinement need many decisions between different programs. These decisions often depend on an experienced researcher who knows how the programs work together and how to read experimental data. We used Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 to supervise this work for 24 cryo-EM and X-ray cases. The work finished in about 36 hours on one workstation. The agent prepared the inputs, ran established programs, read the validation results, compared candidate models and chose the next step. For 15 deposited cryo-EM models with weak starting geometry, the median MolProbity score improved from 2.62 to 1.76. For three crystal structures, the agent models came close to the published Rfree values. Chemical information such as ligands, ions and modifications must be provided by the researcher, in the same way as the sequence. With this information, the agent can place and check these components. These results show that agent supervision is acceptable when every decision can be inspected. The researcher makes the final scientific judgment. We suggest practical requirements for this kind of use. Future AI agents may help researchers obtain high quality and reliable structures of biological macromolecules.
items.summary_zh: 作者以Claude Code和Claude Opus 5.5监督24个cryo-EM和X射线结构建模/精修案例，在一台工作站约36小时完成。15个起始几何较弱的已沉积cryo-EM模型的MolProbity中位分数从2.62改善至1.76，3个晶体结构的Rfree接近已发表值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把智能体用于真实结构生物学软件链的可审计调度，展示了可观的结构质量改进；但化学组分信息仍须人工提供，且研究者必须作最终判断，结果也尚未证明智能体可自主处理未知配体和复杂异常数据。
items.abstract_zh: 结构模型构建和精修需要在不同程序之间作出许多决策。这些决策通常依赖经验丰富的研究人员，他们了解程序如何协同工作，也知道如何解读实验数据。我们使用搭载Claude Opus 5.5的Claude Code，在24个cryo-EM和X射线案例中监督这项工作。这些工作在一台工作站上约36小时完成。该智能体准备输入、运行已有程序、读取验证结果、比较候选模型并选择下一步。对于15个起始几何较弱的已沉积cryo-EM模型，MolProbity分数中位数从2.62提高到1.76。对于三个晶体结构，智能体模型的Rfree值接近已发表值。研究者必须提供配体、离子和修饰等化学信息，正如必须提供序列一样。有了这些信息，智能体可以放置并检查这些组分。这些结果表明，当每个决策都可被检查时，智能体监督是可以接受的。研究者作出最终科学判断。我们提出这类应用的实际要求。未来AI智能体或可帮助研究者获得高质量、可靠的生物大分子结构。

items.title: Chemputing the synthesis and optimisation of arene fluorination in an automated platform
items.abstract_or_text: Positron emission tomography (PET) relies on the rapid and efficient incorporation of fluorine-18 (18F) into molecular imaging agents, yet selecting appropriate radiofluorination conditions for new substrates remains ad hoc. Whilst decades of development have generated a wealth of experimentally validated reactions, this knowledge remains dispersed throughout literature and is difficult to exploit systematically for reaction planning. Here the chemputation-enabled arene radiofluorination, that is optimization and automated execution, captures both reaction transformations and the associated experimental conditions, providing a foundation for reasoning. Three complementary levels of analysis are implemented to interrogate the knowledge base, progressing from molecular similarity and electronic descriptors, through reaction abstraction based on bond–electron matrices, to AI-assisted contextual reasoning. The recommended literature precedents provide experimentally informed starting points that are subsequently refined using an optimization algorithm, enabling efficient exploration of multidimensional reaction-condition space beyond direct literature transfer and the optimized procedure is executed on a robotic platform using the Chemical Description Language (χDL), establishing a continuous digital workflow from literature knowledge to reproducible chemical synthesis. By integrating curated reaction knowledge, computational reasoning, experimental optimization, and digital execution, this work provides a general framework for data-driven radiofluorination that reduces experimental trial-and-error while improving reproducibility, safety, and scalability in PET tracer development.
items.summary_zh: 该工作将芳烃放射氟化的文献知识、分子相似性/电子描述符、键—电子矩阵反应抽象、AI辅助语境推理、条件优化和χDL机器人执行连接起来，形成面向PET示踪剂的连续数字化工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以已验证反应先例为基础，再用算法优化并自动执行，能减少18F标记开发中的试错并提高可复现性；但摘要未给出跨底物的定量成功率或与人工方案的严格对照，泛化程度仍待评估。
items.abstract_zh: 正电子发射断层成像（PET）依赖于将fluorine-18（18F）快速且高效地引入分子成像剂；然而，为新底物选择合适的放射氟化条件仍带有临时性。尽管数十年的发展已经产生了丰富的实验验证反应，但这些知识仍分散在文献中，难以被系统地用于反应规划。这里，支持化学计算的芳烃放射氟化——即优化和自动化执行——同时捕获反应转化及相关实验条件，为推理提供基础。为探究该知识库，实施了三个互补层级的分析：从分子相似性和电子描述符，进展到基于键—电子矩阵的反应抽象，再到AI辅助的语境推理。推荐的文献先例提供了由实验信息支撑的起点，随后利用优化算法加以细化，从而能够在超越直接文献迁移的多维反应条件空间中高效探索；优化后的流程则使用Chemical Description Language（χDL）在机器人平台上执行，建立从文献知识到可复现化学合成的连续数字工作流。通过整合经整理的反应知识、计算推理、实验优化和数字化执行，这项工作为数据驱动的放射氟化提供了通用框架，可在PET示踪剂开发中减少实验试错，同时提高可复现性、安全性和可扩展性。
items.author_line: Filippo Protti, Nathan Jiscoot, Nicholas Capittini, Christian Knittl-Frank, Dean Thomas, Alessio Porta, Emanuele Casali, Giuseppe Zanoni, Leroy Cronin

items.title: Improved electrostatic machine learning embedding ML/MM scheme for a phosphoryl transfer reaction
items.abstract_or_text: The promise of hybrid machine learning/molecular mechanics (ML/MM) simulations is to provide QM/MM-quality free energy profiles at a fraction of the cost. One of the challenges is to accurately treat the interaction between the ML subsystem and the MM environment. Here we test the Electrostatic ML Embedding (EMLE) scheme on a minimal model of RNA cleavage in water, which is already challenging due to a doubly charged reactant dissociating into two anions. The original scheme, a MACE potential embedded by an independent EMLE model, is compared with a new EMLE–MACE architecture, in which a single equivariant network predicts the gas-phase energy together with the atomic charges, valence widths, polarizabilities and static dipoles required by the embedding. The models were trained by active learning against M06-2X/def2- TZVP data, with structures selected by query-by-committee from the ML/MM dynamics itself. About 1500 single point calculations were sufficient for stable 100 ps umbrella sampling simulations in 73 windows along the reaction pathway. The EMLE–MACE profile reproduces the reference DFT/MM profile within its sampling error, including a metastable pentacoordinate intermediate. Energy decomposition shows that the static dipoles are essential: without them the static error stays above chemical accuracy even for an ideally trained model, due to the irreducible error of approximating electron density with spherical atoms.
items.summary_zh: 作者在水中RNA裂解的磷酰基转移反应上测试改进的EMLE–MACE ML/MM嵌入方案。模型以约1,500个M06-2X/def2-TZVP单点计算经主动学习训练，可稳定完成73个窗口、100 ps的umbrella sampling，并在采样误差内复现DFT/MM自由能曲线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对带电反应环境中ML/MM耦合这一关键难点，以主动学习和自由能剖面验证提出了更有物理意义的极化/偶极表示；但体系是最小RNA模型，向酶催化或更复杂溶液化学迁移仍需实证。
items.abstract_zh: 混合机器学习/分子力学（ML/MM）模拟有望以远低于成本的代价提供QM/MM质量的自由能剖面。其中一项挑战，是准确处理ML子系统与MM环境之间的相互作用。这里，我们在水中RNA裂解的一个最小模型上测试Electrostatic ML Embedding（EMLE）方案；该体系已很具挑战性，因为一个带双负电荷的反应物会解离为两个阴离子。原始方案由独立EMLE模型嵌入的MACE势能构成；我们将其与新的EMLE–MACE架构比较，在后者中，单个等变网络预测气相能量，以及嵌入所需的原子电荷、价层宽度、极化率和静态偶极。模型通过主动学习，利用从ML/MM动力学自身经query-by-committee选择的结构，针对M06-2X/def2-TZVP数据进行训练。约1500个单点计算足以沿反应路径的73个窗口进行稳定的100 ps umbrella sampling模拟。EMLE–MACE剖面在其采样误差内再现参考DFT/MM剖面，包括一个亚稳态五配位中间体。能量分解表明静态偶极至关重要：若无静态偶极，即使模型经过理想训练，静态误差仍高于化学精度，因为用球形原子近似电子密度存在不可约误差。
items.author_line: Laetitia Kantin, Iñaki Tuñón, Kirill Zinovjev, Elise Duboué Dijon

items.title: PepRePs: Peptide-Retargeted Phosphatases Designed with Generative Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Phosphorylation is a fast, reversible layer of post-translational control that directly governs protein activity, signaling flux, and cell state. Kinases and phosphatases collectively establish these phosphorylation states, but their dysregulation drives cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, and developmental disorders. Selectively manipulating the phosphorylation of individual proteins in cells remains challenging, particularly for disordered substrates. Here, we introduce Peptide-Retargeted Phosphatases (PepRePs), a genetically encoded system that fuses a peptide binder to a serine/threonine phosphatase subunit to localize phosphatase activity to a target protein. We first establish the PepReP architecture using characterized tau-binding peptides, then apply protein language model-guided peptide design to target Rab8A, PTEN, and STAT3. Across endogenous and exogenous targets, PepRePs reduce phosphorylation, with downstream effects on tau aggregation, Rab8A-associated protein interactions, and cellular proliferation following PTEN and STAT3 targeting. Sequence-based peptide design enables targeting without structural inputs, supporting application to substrates with disordered regions that challenge conventional structure-based binder design. By coupling programmable peptide binders with modular phosphatase subunits, PepRePs enable targeted control of protein phosphorylation to probe cellular signaling and develop strategies for correcting disease-associated protein dysfunction.
items.summary_zh: PepRePs将肽结合剂融合至丝氨酸/苏氨酸磷酸酶亚基，使酶活定位到靶蛋白；蛋白语言模型引导的肽设计成功面向Rab8A、PTEN和STAT3，并在细胞中降低磷酸化、影响tau聚集、蛋白互作和细胞增殖。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该策略把生成式蛋白语言模型与模块化磷酸酶连接，可能扩展至难以采用结构导向方法的无序底物；但选择性、脱靶去磷酸化及递送/体内安全性尚未在摘要中得到充分解决。
items.abstract_zh: 磷酸化是翻译后调控中快速、可逆的一层，直接控制蛋白活性、信号通量和细胞状态。激酶和磷酸酶共同建立这些磷酸化状态，但其失调会驱动癌症、神经退行性疾病和发育障碍。在细胞中选择性操控单个蛋白的磷酸化仍具挑战性，尤其是针对无序底物。这里，我们引入Peptide-Retargeted Phosphatases（PepRePs），这是一个遗传编码系统，将肽结合剂与丝氨酸/苏氨酸磷酸酶亚基融合，使磷酸酶活性定位到靶蛋白。我们首先利用已表征的tau结合肽建立PepReP架构，随后应用蛋白语言模型引导的肽设计来靶向Rab8A、PTEN和STAT3。对于内源和外源靶标，PepRePs均降低磷酸化，并对tau聚集、Rab8A相关蛋白相互作用以及PTEN和STAT3靶向后的细胞增殖产生下游影响。基于序列的肽设计无需结构输入即可实现靶向，从而支持应用于对传统结构导向结合剂设计构成挑战的无序区域底物。通过将可编程肽结合剂与模块化磷酸酶亚基耦合，PepRePs能够对蛋白磷酸化进行靶向控制，以探究细胞信号传导并开发纠正疾病相关蛋白功能障碍的策略。
items.author_line: Hong, L., Ho, T.-C., Tseng, Y.-S., Vincoff, S., Chen, T., Donahue, T. C., DeLisa, M. P., Chen, P.-H., Chatterjee, P.

items.title: sORF-Trans2MS: a two-module deep learning framework for sORF translation and MS-supported microprotein prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Ribosome profiling is widely used to identify translated small open reading frames (sORFs), but existing prediction models often generalize poorly to newly collected sORF datasets. In addition, many microproteins with strong mass spectrometry (MS) evidence lack support in public Ribo-seq resources, suggesting that Ribo-supported sORF and MS-supported microprotein detection may represent complementary prediction tasks. Here, we developed sORF-Trans2MS, a two-module deep learning framework for predicting Ribo-supported sORFs and MS-supported microproteins. Module I uses RNA-FM representations for upstream, ORF, and downstream regions with a Transformer encoder for Ribo-supported sORF translation prediction. Module II integrates pretrained RNA-FM representations of RNA context with ESM-2 protein representations using multi-scale CNN encoders for predicting translated microproteins supported by MS but not Ribo-seq data. Module I was trained on 9,579 Ribo-supported sORFs and matched background sORFs, while Module II used 14,697 MS-supported (MS++Ribo-) microproteins and matched backgrounds. Module I achieved an AUROC of 0.870 internally and 0.930 on an independent GENCODE dataset. Ablation analysis highlighted upstream RNA context, including a distinct signal around 50 nt upstream of AUG. Module II achieved an AUROC/AUPR of 0.804/0.797 internally and 0.785/0.773 on an independent mass spectrometry dataset. Model interpretation highlighted upstream RNA context and the protein N terminus, while literature-supported microproteins further illustrated the complementary roles of the two modules. Overall, sORF-Trans2MS improves prediction and generalization of Ribo-supported sORFs and extends computational discovery to MS-supported candidates that are not represented in current public Ribo-seq resources.
items.summary_zh: sORF-Trans2MS以RNA-FM、ESM-2和深度学习分别预测Ribo-seq支持的sORF翻译和MS支持但缺少Ribo-seq证据的微蛋白。两个模块在独立数据集上分别达到AUROC 0.930，以及AUROC/AUPR 0.785/0.773。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该双模块设计将核糖体测序与质谱证据互补地纳入微蛋白发现，并提供独立测试与消融分析；但预测候选物仍需靶向质谱或功能实验确认，训练数据和标注定义也可能影响跨实验室泛化。
items.abstract_zh: 核糖体图谱测序广泛用于识别发生翻译的小开放阅读框（sORFs），但现有预测模型对新收集的sORF数据集往往泛化不佳。此外，许多具有强质谱（MS）证据的微蛋白缺乏公共Ribo-seq资源的支持，这表明Ribo支持的sORF和MS支持的微蛋白检测可能代表互补的预测任务。这里，我们开发了sORF-Trans2MS，一个用于预测Ribo支持的sORF和MS支持的微蛋白的双模块深度学习框架。模块I使用上游、ORF和下游区域的RNA-FM表征，并配合Transformer编码器，进行Ribo支持的sORF翻译预测。模块II将RNA上下文的预训练RNA-FM表征与ESM-2蛋白表征整合，使用多尺度CNN编码器预测由MS支持、但没有Ribo-seq数据支持的翻译微蛋白。模块I在9,579个Ribo支持的sORF及其匹配背景sORF上训练；模块II使用14,697个MS支持（MS++Ribo-）微蛋白及其匹配背景。模块I内部AUROC达到0.870，在独立GENCODE数据集上达到0.930。消融分析突出显示了上游RNA上下文的作用，包括AUG上游约50 nt处的独特信号。模块II内部AUROC/AUPR达到0.804/0.797，在独立质谱数据集上达到0.785/0.773。模型解释突出显示上游RNA上下文和蛋白N端，而有文献支持的微蛋白进一步说明两个模块的互补作用。总体而言，sORF-Trans2MS提高了对Ribo支持sORF的预测和泛化，并将计算发现扩展至当前公共Ribo-seq资源中未呈现的MS支持候选物。
items.author_line: He, J., Sui, J., Chen, Q., Hu, H., Tan, C. S. H.

items.title: AntiCapt: Fine-Tuned Nucleotide Language Models for Predicting and Designing Anticancer Aptamers
items.abstract_or_text: Over the past decade, aptamers have emerged as promising therapeutics, with cancer therapeutics as a major research area. Existing computational methods, however, either predict aptamer-target pairs or design aptamers against a specific target. In this study, we present AntiCapt, a computational method for identifying single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) anticancer aptamers (ACAs) using sequence descriptors and fine-tuned nucleotide language models. The main dataset comprises 1,021 experimentally validated ACAs and an equal number of non-aptamer sequences. Comparative analysis revealed distinct patterns in the nucleotide, dinucleotide, and trinucleotide compositions associated with ACAs. We developed machine learning (ML) models using composition, autocorrelation, binary profiles and structural features. Among these, the best-performing composition-based model achieved an AUC of 0.93 on an independent dataset, while chemical descriptor-and structural feature-based models achieved a maximum AUC of 0.89. ML models using pretrained and fine-tuned NLM embeddings were also developed, with fine-tuned HyenaDNA embeddings achieving the highest performance, with an independent AUC of 0.94. Furthermore, we developed a model for discriminating anticancer aptamers from general aptamers. The best-performing models were integrated into AntiCapt, a web server and a standalone tool for predicting, designing, and genome-scale scanning anticancer aptamers (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/anticapt/).
items.summary_zh: AntiCapt基于1,021条经实验验证的ssDNA抗癌适配体及等量非适配体，比较序列描述符和核苷酸语言模型；微调HyenaDNA在独立集上的AUC为0.94，并被集成为适配体预测、设计和全基因组扫描工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作为抗癌适配体的序列级筛选与设计提供了独立测试支持的模型和可用工具；但分类性能并不直接证明结合亲和力、细胞活性或临床可开发性，生成候选仍需严格实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 过去十年中，适配体已成为有前景的治疗手段，其中癌症治疗是主要研究领域。现有计算方法要么预测适配体—靶标配对，要么针对特定靶标设计适配体。然而，在本研究中，我们提出AntiCapt，一种使用序列描述符和微调核苷酸语言模型识别单链DNA（ssDNA）抗癌适配体（ACAs）的计算方法。主要数据集包含1,021条经实验验证的ACA和数量相等的非适配体序列。比较分析揭示了与ACA相关的核苷酸、二核苷酸和三核苷酸组成中的不同模式。我们利用组成、自相关、二进制谱和结构特征开发了机器学习（ML）模型。其中，表现最佳的基于组成模型在独立数据集上达到0.93的AUC，而基于化学描述符和结构特征的模型最高达到0.89的AUC。我们还开发了使用预训练和微调NLM嵌入的ML模型，其中微调HyenaDNA嵌入表现最佳，在独立数据集上达到0.94的AUC。此外，我们开发了用于区分抗癌适配体与一般适配体的模型。表现最佳的模型被整合至AntiCapt，这是一个用于预测、设计和全基因组扫描抗癌适配体的网页服务器和独立工具（https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/anticapt/）。
items.author_line: Bajiya, N., Mehta, N. K., Raghava, G. P. S.
